description: Structure 1 canonical CBOR fixture — the ONE layout. RFC 8949 §4.2.1.
_note: Canonical CBOR of the 8-element positional TBS array. There is one layout and every field is required; the earlier six- and seven-field fixtures were deleted with the tolerances they pinned (CELLO is alpha with no users, so backward compatibility is an anti-requirement).
_why: The two hashes are the point. last_seen_hash chains a sender to their counterparty; prev_own_hash chains them to themselves. Without the second, two messages one party sends back to back carry identical acknowledgements — nothing arrived in between — so nothing in the signed bytes says which came first. The relay-assigned position cannot help: it is assigned after the sender signs.
